notes.title: Minor bugfixes and changes
notes.content:
[h1]Hi everybody![/h1]

We made some small changes and fixes to the game since the launch, here's a list with them:

[list]
[*]  Dropped coins by Robin are now automatically picked up
[*]  As pointed out by an user, if you had inverted the camera on the X axis, the camera rotated towards the wrong side when moving around. This is fixed now.
[*]  Also, the settings to disable that characteristic were not working, it should be fixed now.
[*]  Added a message when applying settings so it's clearer that they are saved
[*]  Now you can skip the texts that appear when a camera was moving after triggering a cinematic or pushing a button, allowing for a faster expierience for those that don't care too much about the story
[*]  Fixed a bug that made you die twice if you were killed by an enemy and also fell into water
[*]  Fixed the rare but possible infinite camera shake when killing an enemy
[*]  Fixed a rare bug that made the player invisible on some cases
[*]  The controls for the wallclimb function are now displayed while doing it
[*]  To help in the wallclimb, we added a functionality to make sticking to those surfaces easier when not jumping straight to them
[*]  Added an introduction cinematic to the first level
[*]  Changes to nav meshes of some enemies on certain maps that could get stuck or work unintendedly
[/list]

Although we (hopefully) listed every change and bugfix, we may have fixed more bugs or missed some.

If you find anything that you think we should take a look into, please don't hesitate to reach out, we'll try and fix anything we can to make the game better.
